understand.concept: stdlib.h declares general utilities including strtol-family conversions, malloc-family allocation, qsort, bsearch, rand and process termination functions. Each interface has specific preconditions and return-value rules.
understand.whyItMatters: This header contains widely used facilities, but their contracts differ: parsing needs range checks, allocation needs ownership, and sorting/searching needs consistent comparison rules.
